shots.subject: A timber chalet on a steep snowy slope with every window glowing warm, string lights along its balcony and roof edge, chimney smoke rising, jagged snowy peaks under a deep blue sky behind
A steep A-frame cabin among tall snowy pines, its triangular glass front glowing with a lit Christmas tree inside, fairy lights along the roof edges and smoke from a metal chimney
The snowy wooden deck of a log cabin with a decorated Christmas tree glowing at its corner, lanterns on the rail, lit glass doors behind and a valley of snowy peaks beyond
shots.focus: the lit tree on the deck

shots.subject: A snowy mountain road winding up to a lone log cabin at its end, lantern posts along the last stretch, a lit wreath on the gate and smoke rising from the chimney
shots.focus: the cabin at the end of the road

shots.subject: A cluster of small wooden cabins in a snowy high valley, each with glowing windows and warm lights on the eaves, chimney smoke drifting, a frozen stream curving between them
A remote log cabin under a clear starry sky with the Milky Way arching over the peaks, windows glowing warm and fairy lights on the porch, smoke from the chimney
shots.focus: the starry sky above the cabin
shots.motion_elements: the cabin lights, the chimney smoke and the twinkling stars
shots.ambient: Stars twinkle over the peaks. Chimney smoke drifts slowly.

shots.subject: The front porch of a mountain cabin with a pine wreath on the door, stacked firewood, a pair of old snowshoes on the wall and warm string lights under the porch roof, snow falling beyond the posts
shots.motion_elements: the porch lights and the falling snow

shots.subject: A stone-and-timber mountain hut perched on a rocky ridge, glowing windows, a line of lanterns marking the snowy path up to it, clouds filling the valley below
shots.motion_elements: the hut lights, the lanterns, the chimney smoke and the drifting clouds
shots.ambient: Snow falls lightly. Clouds drift slowly in the valley below. Chimney smoke rises.

shots.subject: A log cabin beside a half-frozen mountain stream, a small wooden bridge with fairy lights leading to its lit door, snowy boulders and smoke from the chimney
shots.motion_elements: the cabin lights, the flowing stream, the chimney smoke and the falling snow
shots.ambient: Snow falls. The stream flows past the boulders. Chimney smoke drifts slowly.

shots.subject: Close view of a cabin window seen from outside, a candle and a small lit wreath on the inner sill, warm fairy lights around the frame, fresh snow piled on the outer sill
shots.motion_elements: the candle flame, the fairy lights and the falling snow
shots.ambient: The candle flickers behind the glass. Snow falls past the window.

shots.subject: A tiny cabin high on an open snowy mountainside seen from far away, its warm windows and roof lights the only glow in a vast blue landscape
The snowy backyard of a cabin with a steaming wooden hot tub, lanterns and warm string lights around it, snowy pines and peaks behind
shots.motion_elements: the steam, the string lights and the falling snow
shots.ambient: Snow falls. Steam rises from the hot tub. Chimney smoke drifts behind.

shots.subject: A mountain cabin at sunset with golden alpenglow on the peaks, warm lights on its balcony, long blue shadows across the fresh snow and thin chimney smoke
shots.motion_elements: the balcony lights, the chimney smoke and the drifting clouds
shots.ambient: Chimney smoke drifts slowly. Clouds drift past the glowing peaks.

shots.subject: The side of a log cabin with a window glowing warm and a lit tree visible inside, a snowy wooden sled leaning below it and icicles along the eaves lit by fairy lights
Close view of a stone chimney on a snowy cabin roof, wood smoke curling up into the blue dusk, warm fairy lights along the roof ridge and pine tops behind
A modern black timber cabin with tall glass walls on a snowy cliff edge above a deep valley, a lit tree glowing inside and warm lights along its terrace
shots.focus: the glass cabin on the cliff

shots.subject: Two small cabins sharing a snowy yard, warm string lights zig-zagging between their roofs, a lit tree in the middle and lanterns on the fence
shots.focus: the lit tree between the cabins

shots.subject: Close view of a cabin door with a big pine wreath, a red ribbon and warm fairy lights, a brass lantern glowing beside it and snow drifted against the threshold
shots.motion_elements: the lantern flame, the fairy lights and the falling snow
shots.ambient: The lantern flame flickers. Snow falls past the door.

shots.subject: A cabin on a snowy saddle between two peaks, a long line of lanterns and fairy-lit posts leading up the ridge path, valley lights twinkling far below
An old alpine stone cottage with a slate roof heavy with snow, green shutters, warm lit windows and a lit garland over the door, smoke from its chimney and pine forest behind
